title: The statue
summary: The club is putting up a statue of the legend outside the main stand, and he wants you to pull the sheet off. It doesn't look much like him. A season on, somebody puts a scarf on it.

ends.title: The sheet
ends.text: You pulled the sheet off the legend's statue. He says it's got your nose.

ends.title: In the crowd
ends.text: You watched the statue go up from the crowd.

beats.title: Under the sheet

event.title: Under the sheet
event.speaker: legend
setup: There's a shape under a white sheet outside the main stand. {legend.name} is standing next to it in the club tie, looking worried. He saw it this morning.

say: "They want a current player to pull the sheet. I asked for you. Before you say yes, it doesn't look like me. It looks like a postman."
"Saturday, half two. Pull from the left, it catches on the right ear."

yes.text: Saturday. You pull from the left. It's very much a postman, a bronze postman with a ball. {legend.short} says "lovely" four times and goes for a sit down.

no.text: The captain pulls it, from the right. It catches on the ear. The photo is the captain with a sheet over his head.

beats.hint: The legend is getting a statue

beats.title: The scarf

event.title: The scarf
event.speaker: legend
setup: A season on, a derby. Somebody has put a scarf on the statue, and it's the wrong club's.
{if arc.path=='pulled'}{legend.short} rang you about it at seven this morning.{/if}

choices.label: Take the scarf off before kick-off.

outcomes.text: You climb up on the plinth in your suit and take it off. The fans queuing at the turnstiles sing your name. {legend.short} sends you a text with eleven exclamation marks.
You climb up and take it off. Somebody films it.
The stewards get it down with a broom. {legend.short} says the broom was worse.

beats.hint: A season on, the legend's statue
